name: Gujarat Titans
one_line: Creative producer for Gujarat Titans, two IPL seasons. I planned it, budgeted it, shot it and cut it. When a film was one actor short, I was the actor.
writeup: Two IPL seasons as creative producer on Gujarat Titans. The concept, the budget, the timeline and every call with the client went through me. When a script needed one more character than we had cast, I stepped in and played him.

Junior Titans by GT went to five cities in one month. Each city got a documentary, a city film and a vox pop. I produced the tour and wrote some of the concepts. I shot the vox pops myself, because the schedule had no room for anyone who wasn't already there.
gaps: Logo and text only by rule. No footage, stills or posts were collected. Nothing can be added until the owner clears specific material.

name: Zepto
one_line: A ten-minute delivery brand can't wait ten days for a reel. Every month I turn their briefs into reels at their speed, and sometimes I'm the one in them.
writeup: Zepto delivers groceries in ten minutes, so the content can't take ten days. I'm the creative producer on their monthly reels: budget, timeline, crew and every call with their team.

Most months they send the concept. Some months the concept is mine. Either way it comes back shot, cut and ready to post while the joke is still fresh. I'm also in frame, as a creator on Zepto's own page.
gaps: Four finished reels found, all short. No link to the live posts, and no confirmation of which reels the owner wants shown or which ones he appears in.

name: Palladium
one_line: Festive films for Palladium. The big one was a Christmas CGI film for Palladium Mumbai.
writeup: I shot Palladium's festive films. The biggest of them was Christmas at Palladium Mumbai, a CGI film.
gaps: No Palladium video or still exists on this Mac. The Christmas CGI film and the festive films are missing. The logo on file is the Ahmedabad lockup, not Mumbai.

name: Crav Social
one_line: A page I ran end to end: the idea, the camera, the cut. Over 50 million views while it was mine.
writeup: While I ran Crav Social, every post started as my idea, went through my camera and came out of my edit. No team, no hand-offs.
It crossed 50 million views in that stretch. I've handed it on since.
gaps: Only one finished reel found. Other people are visible in it, so the owner should confirm it can be shown. The reels that carried the 50M+ views are not on this Mac.

name: The DVCs
one_line: Digital video commercials, client by client.

facts.label: Clients
facts.value: Shivalik, Kavyaratna, ABH Developers, Sahaj Group

writeup: Digital video commercials, client by client. Written, shot, cut and delivered, with the client on set.
The clients are Shivalik, Kavyaratna, ABH Developers and Sahaj Group.
gaps: No finished DVC export exists on this Mac for any of the four clients, only Premiere project files. No client logos on file either.
